title: Ackermann Geometry and the Turning Circle: The Bicycle Model, the Two Steering Angles of a Car, the Smallest Circle It Can Drive and the Speed It Can Drive It At

artifact.note: the kinematic bicycle model of a car-like vehicle (reference point at the rear axle), the turning radius for a steering angle and the smallest one, the two front wheel angles of Ackermann steering, the radius swept by the outer front wheel, the curvature to steering angle, and the fastest speed round a circle on a surface
